the '''Whiterock Wastes''' was an area of vast snowy plains on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] set up military outposts in this sector during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], including [[Aurek Base]].
